BETA Close X Ninety One plc has announced the repurchase of 102,335 ordinary shares on August 3, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share was 214.4972 GBp, with the lowest price at 213.4000 GBp and the highest at 215.0000 GBp. These repurchased shares are intended for cancellation. Since June 3, 2026, the company has bought back a total of 7,086,992 shares for £15,199,805.58, leaving 661,585,408 ordinary shares in issue.
